subject.title: Add plan-first Claw status and remove

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this destructive Claws lifecycle only after exclusive package serialization and a durable redacted removal tombstone are part of the contract?
rationale: The patch establishes new core CLI, persistence, deletion, recovery, and audit semantics while the governing RFC and prerequisite stack remain open; code review cannot choose the permanent lifecycle and retention policy.

options.title: Sponsor the complete lifecycle
options.body: Require exclusive package ownership, canonical agent deletion coverage, a redacted tombstone, and exact-head upgrade/concurrency proof before approving the stack.

options.title: Land read-only status first
options.body: Keep authoritative status inventory but defer destructive removal and tombstone schema decisions to a later sponsored slice.

options.title: Pause the Claws stack
options.body: Keep the RFC and stacked PRs open without landing until maintainers choose a different ownership or lifecycle boundary.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the complete lifecycle
recommendation.body: Require exclusive package ownership, canonical agent deletion coverage, a redacted tombstone, and exact-head upgrade/concurrency proof before approving the stack.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest current-main routing candidate across shared SQLite state, config mutation, and filesystem-safety ownership.
